Capturing or storing real payment instruments is out of scope for a simulator.

The cost-saved dashboard (saved so far, this month, run rate, by month / service / top resources) and the monthly invoices are derived from the live inventory at real-Azure list prices accrued from each resource's creation. Invoices are marked simulated: amountDue is 0.00, avoidedAmount is the would-be charge. Deleted resources leave no ledger, so past months are a lower bound. Payment methods are never collected.
